source.json:poster-saved-tx: Saved poster: tx is always URL-encoded (c_scale%2Cw_400). v4 encoded it only when another query parameter followed; the service answers both forms the same.
player.json:player-usage-report-off: Saved poster: tx is always URL-encoded (c_limit%2Cw_700), as v4 did whenever _s=vp followed; the service answers both forms the same.
player.json:player-poster-options: Default poster is the saved poster with posterOptions.transformation as tx (FR-038, contracts/options.md); v4 used the video still.
player.json:player-seek-thumbnails: Saved poster gets the image-safe source transformation (tx=w_500), as the seek-thumbnail sprite does; v4 sent an empty tx.
